title: Flying4Diamonds
description:
this plugin is  for Paper Servers running Minecraft 1.21.10
flying4diamonds is great plugin for offering your players creative flight at a cost of resources with different adjustable tiers.
body:
![project img](https://i.postimg.cc/8skK8vMk/F4D.png)

**Welcome to FLYING4DIAMONDS**

Simple plugin for Paper Minecraft Servers running 1.21.10

Drag and drop into your servers plugin folder and restart your server
once complete startup is finished in game type /flight and be presented with a GUI offering 1 hr of creative flight for the cost of 1 Diamond and just above your hearts and Armour will be a count down timer which will Pause 
when a player lands back to the ground also gives you a warining when your getting low on time 

Hope you Enjoy 
This is my 1st ever plugin i have enjoyed making it i hope you enjoy using it
